svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version A: non-bedroom rooms over part of the garage, no attic
svg.desc: Version A furnished diagram updated for implemented rear alignment at z6.65 feet. Primary bathroom is 13.55 by 9.8 feet clear, retaining the original 33.6 by 62.4-inch tub, rotated 42 by 72-inch shower, 60 and 48-inch vanities and enclosed northwest WC with inward south door. Bedroom enters the closet then bathroom; every room door remains 96 inches tall and closed by default. Closet main envelope is 13.55 by 6.2 feet plus an open 6.85 by 3.4-foot linen extension between separate gallery bedroom routes. All three original five-foot hanging bays, five rods, both six-level full-size shelf units, drawer bank and clothes remain. Narrow hanging aisle is 26.4 inches; bathroom aisle 30.6 inches; gallery side routes 34.5 inches including baseboards. Occupied comfort, accessibility and simultaneous use are not approved. Tub/shower bodies and tub faucet/WC paint face are 4.5 inches apart each; selected-product enclosure, cleaning, service and waterproofing review required. Gross upstairs is 1,892.5042 square feet, 93.275 less than before rear alignment. Ground remains 1,966.4427, combined 3,858.9469. All other rooms and openings, fixed stair and saved layout data remain unchanged. Purple dashed lines show ground garage coverage by laundry, east Bath 4 and mechanical, never bedroom interiors. Version H remains an unadopted different alternative. Roof, upper floors/support, garage fire separation, plumbing, wet-area electrical, glazing, drainage and occupied operation require professional review; not construction drawings.
